description: Manages the row of modules beside it as a group: it disables, randomises, saves, loads, copies and pastes them together.

params.text: Cycles which modules are managed: those on both sides, those on the left only, or those on the right only, shown by the triangular lights.
Enables the managed modules, or toggles them between enabled and disabled, depending on the mode picked on the menu.
Hold it to enter parameter learn mode, then click parameters to include them in or exclude them from randomisation.

inputs.text: Enables the managed modules; the menu sets whether this port acts on a trigger, as a toggle, or by gate level.
A trigger disables the managed modules.
A trigger randomises the managed modules, following the include and exclude list.

notes: a strip is the unbroken row of modules next to this one; leaving a gap in the row is what sets its extent.
menu: Save as — writes the strip to a .vcvss file holding every module's settings, the cables between them and their parameter mappings; Load, Load with replace, Cut, Copy and Paste are beside it.
Randomize parameters only — randomises knobs, faders and switches and leaves each module's internal state untouched.
Port/Switch ON mode — On only enables the modules, Toggle flips them on each press, and High/Low follows the level at the port.
Preset — lists the .vcvss files in the plugin’s own Strip preset folder, with Open folder and Load and replace above them; a Demo strip is shipped there.
Mode — on the INC/EXC button's own right-click menu: All, Exclude or Include, with Learn and Clear and every parameter already chosen, each offering Remove from list.
